notes: Method: parsed the ExamSIDE JEE Main Mathematics chapter pages (questions.examside.com/past-years/jee/jee-main/mathematics/<chapter>, saved in this session's scratchpad as esm/*.html). I rebuilt the MathJax math in each question and read every 2024-2026 question in the relevant chapters (2024: 600, 2025: 475, 2026: 474; this is every shift of both sessions, matching 30 or 25 questions per shift). I also searched other chapters by keyword for topics that cross chapters: greatest integer and modulus, even/odd integrals, infinite GP, log equations, omega, tangency, limit of a sum, L'Hospital limits. I opened 3 individual ExamSIDE question pages to check options (2026 Jan 21 S2 sets question = A-B, so it counts; 2024 Apr 5 S2 and 2024 Feb 1 S1 composite-function questions ask about one-one/onto, not continuity, so they do not count). As a cross-check, MathonGo chapter PDFs (Jan 2024, Apr 2024, Jan 2026) also have zero plane questions in 3D and zero tangent/normal questions in AOD. A question counts only if the topic is needed to solve it, so the counts involve judgement. The ones marked 'medium' depend most on judgement: (1) Log laws, change of base and log inequalities count only questions where log manipulation is the core step (mostly nested-log domain questions and log equations), not every question that mentions log. (2) 'Absolute value, greatest integer and power functions' is counted across chapters: Functions, Definite Integration with [x], continuity with [x]/|x|, and modulus equations in Quadratics (4 per year). It is a lower bound. (3) 'Properties of determinants' includes |kA|=k^n|A|, |AB|=|A||B| and |adj A|=|A|^(n-1) chains, as well as row/column-operation simplifications. NTA does name 'adjoint', so a narrower reading (row/column properties only) would give roughly 3-4 per year. (4) L'Hospital counts 0/0 limits where the standard limits are not enough (order 3 and above with unknown constants, or limits of integrals). These can also be done by series expansion. (5) Triple products count vector-chapter questions where the box product or the a x (b x c) expansion is the intended route. Strong zeros: no 2024-2026 Main question on planes (equation, point-plane distance, angles), coplanar lines, shift of origin, family of circles, normals to ellipse/hyperbola, LMVT, elementary row operations, comparing distributions (coefficient of variation), or the fundamental theorem of algebra. This fits NTA's 2024 syllabus cut, which removed planes and tangents/normals/MVT. Trig-equation topics overlap: one question can count under several of the 5 sub-topics. Every topic was checked, so there are no null counts.
